journey: An agent hits its concurrency wall — clean, preventive, machine-readable

narrative.step: a well-behaved agent PRE-CHECKS capacity via /v1/usage before spawning
narrative.assertion: pre-check: cap=1, active=0 — headroom for exactly one

narrative.step: the agent takes its one allowed slot
the (cap+1)th acquire is a clean, PREVENTIVE 429 over_cap — before any box spawns
narrative.assertion: wall → 429 over_cap, no box (preventive backpressure, not a crash)

artifact.body: {"code":"over_cap","message":"concurrency cap reached: rejected preventively, before any box/VM"}

narrative.step: a MALFORMED acquire is a 400 — a DISTINCT signal the agent can tell apart from the 429
narrative.assertion: malformed acquire → 400 (≠ 429: over_cap and invalid are machine-distinguishable)

narrative.step: releasing the slot clears the wall — the next acquire is admitted
narrative.assertion: close 200 → next acquire 200 HELD (back off, retry, admitted)

narrative.step: records the honest note — the direct-door "Waiting for a runner" analogue is a GAP
narrative.assertion: the fabric-door 429 over_cap is LIVE; the direct-door queue analogue (a job stays "Waiting for a runner" until a slot frees) is not observable via the API here
